messages:
maya: Quick async check-in for kernel + KV sprint — where are we on the milestone list? any blockers for the canary rollout this week?

sam: small update: kernel PR #402 landed yesterday, but I'm seeing a 3-4% perf regression on short sequences in integ tests. digging.

odell: pinging: last perf run before canary showed KV warmup hit, cold starts ~120ms higher on p3. I suspect prefetch order mismatch.

maya: @sam can you paste the regression logs? @odell is that on dedicated pods or canary infra?

sam: pasted quick snippet from the run: ```
2026-03-15T17:02:13Z INFO request_id=abc123 latency=9.7ms tokens=12 kernel_path=mmha_opt
2026-03-15T17:02:14Z INFO request_id=abc124 latency=14.5ms tokens=12 kernel_path=mmha_opt
2026-03-15T17:02:15Z WARN request_id=abc125 latency=24.1ms tokens=12 kernel_path=mmha_fallback
```

sam: looks like some requests hit fallback kernel, likely due to kv ordering?

elaine: the canary infra was a mix of dedicated and spot yesterday. odell, that aligns with your observation.

odell: confirmed. dedicated hosts had normal numbers, but spot-backed nodes showed higher cold start overhead and KV misses. tracking with `kv-prefetch-trace` enabled.

jen: from the rollout plan doc: canary depends on infra team flipping prefetch flag + runtime PR merge. who owns flipping the flag?

maya: ownership: runtime owns the flag toggle but infra does final DNS/drain. sam, can you coordinate with infra? (cc @odell)

sam: will do. infra ticket created: INF-1127. I added steps to run `./scripts/kv_prefetch_check.sh` post-toggle.

ci-bot: build #789 completed: tests=214 passed=212 failed=2 — failing tests are flaky related to seq2seq timeout.

odell: re flaky tests — those are unrelated but block safe-deploy. I'll file a flake-hunt ticket today.

maya: action items: 1) sam to add kernel guard to avoid fallback on short seqs (ETA EOD). 2) odell to triage KV prefetch ordering on spot nodes (ETA tomorrow morning). 3) jen to confirm infra toggle window (ETA today). 4) elaine to coordinate canary timing with SRE (ETA after infra window).

sam: noted. quick snippet for kernel guard I'm prototyping: `if (seq_len <= 16) use_mmha_fast(); else use_mmha_opt();` will post PR link shortly.

jen: infra window confirmed: Thu 0200-0400 UTC. recommending canary immediately after window.

maya: thanks — let's keep async updates here. if anything critical, ping #oncall. :thumbsup:

sam: PR: https://git.internal/r/402 (draft) — running perf bench now, will share numbers.

odell: started KV trace on spot nodes, sending logs to shared drive. I'll link when done.

elaine: FYI I'll block the canary start until CI flakes are resolved. we'll coordinate next steps in the morning.

maya: cool. last question: any data regressions expected due to kernel changes (e.g., tokenization or random seeds)?

sam: none expected — changes are scheduling/kernel selection only. adding unit checks to be safe.

maya: perfect. closing async check-in — please update this thread with PR links and infra ticket numbers.

jen: INF-1127 (related infra ticket) mirrored to oncall.

ci-bot: note: nightly perf job scheduled for 03-16 02:00 UTC.
